html:
Question 4
?

Consider a linear transformation T. If T(3v1+7v2)=[135] and T(v2)=[1−1], then find T(v1).

a
[−46]
b
[32]
c
[612]
d
[−43]
e
[24]
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

Since T is a linear transformation, we have that

T(kv+hw)=T(kv)+T(hw)=kT(v)+hT(w)

for any vectors v and w. Therefore,

T(3v1+7v2)=3T(v1)+7T(v2)[135]=3T(v1)+7[1−1]3T(v1)=[135]−7[1−1]3T(v1)=[135]−[7−7]3T(v1)=[612]T(v1)=13[612]T(v1)=[24].
